description: Test suite for the HpackVarintEncoder class, verifying integer encoding in HTTP/2 HPACK variable-length integer encoding.

methods.name: HpackVarintEncoderTest.Short
methods.description: Tests encoding of integers that fit within the prefix bits.

methods.name: HpackVarintEncoderTest.Long
methods.description: Tests encoding of integers that require extension bytes.

methods.name: HpackVarintEncoderTest.LastByteIsZero
methods.description: Ensures the encoder outputs the last byte even when it is zero.

methods.name: HpackVarintEncoderTest.Append
methods.description: Verifies that encoding appends correctly to existing strings.
